project: KitchenOps — commercial kitchen inventory depletion and smart restock logistics

requirements.description: A new user signs up with an e-mail address and logs in with the 4-digit code sent to it; no passwords are stored.
requirements.acceptance: The code arrives by e-mail within one minute; entering it within 10 minutes logs the user in; an expired or wrong code is refused with a message.

requirements.description: A kitchen chef logs prepared dish portions on mobile, and the server automatically deducts raw ingredient stocks based on the recipe bill of materials.
requirements.acceptance: Logging 10 portions of a recipe containing 120g pasta and 80g sauce deducts exactly 1.2kg pasta and 0.8kg sauce from active stock, generating an audit log in under two seconds.

requirements.description: When an ingredient's stock level drops below its safety threshold, the server automatically appends the required replenishment quantity to the active supplier purchase order.
requirements.acceptance: Cooking cream stock dropping below the 5-liter safety threshold triggers an automatic 20-liter replenishment entry in the pending supplier purchase order sheet.

requirements.description: The system tags inbound ingredient crates with batch arrival and expiration dates, enforcing First-In First-Out (FIFO) usage priority and alerting staff 48 hours prior to spoilage.
requirements.acceptance: Batches expiring within 48 hours display an amber alert banner on mobile and web; recipes automatically draw quantities from the oldest unexpired batch.

requirements.description: A receiving staff member records inbound wholesale deliveries on mobile by entering quantities and lot dates, instantly incrementing warehouse inventory.
requirements.acceptance: Submitting a received delivery of 25kg flour updates the active inventory count by 25kg and creates an inbound receipt record visible on the web dashboard.

requirements.description: Every screen is usable on a phone about 390 px wide without horizontal scrolling.
requirements.acceptance: Every screen opened on a 390 px wide phone (or the browser's phone view): no horizontal scroll bar, no text cut off, every button reachable.

requirements.description: Inventory stock deductions initiated from the mobile app synchronize and update the web dashboard inventory monitor within three seconds.
requirements.acceptance: Confirming a dish preparation on mobile reflects the updated ingredient balance on the web client in under three seconds over standard Wi-Fi/4G.

requirements.description: The server API returns ingredient catalogs, active purchase orders, and stock levels in under 800 milliseconds for catalogs up to 500 items.
requirements.acceptance: Querying the 200-item kitchen pantry inventory endpoint responds in under 800 milliseconds measured across twenty consecutive requests.
